_README: Hand-verified repairs for defects in the UPSTREAM statute sources.
This file is committed (CLAUDE.md .gitignore: data/mappings/ is source of
truth) and is the ONLY sanctioned place to add statutory text that did not
come out of an ingested source. Every entry must be transcribed from real
gazette or India Code text and have its provenance recorded in 'source'.
Text must NEVER be written here from memory or generated by a model. A
system whose premise is that a citation is real only if it exists in
ingested data cannot have invented provisions seeded into its own corpus.
An entry with an empty 'text' is an ACKNOWLEDGED GAP: the ingest reports it
and omits the section rather than emitting a stub the verifier would bless.

304B.text:
(1) Where the death of a woman is caused by any burns or bodily injury or occurs otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of her marriage and it is shown that soon before her death she was subjected to cruelty or harassment by her husband or any relative of her husband for, or in connection with, any demand for dowry, such death shall be called "dowry death", and such husband or relative shall be deemed to have caused her death.
Explanation.-For the purposes of this sub-section, "dowry" shall have the same meaning as in section 2 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (28 of 1961).
(2) Whoever commits dowry death shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than seven years but which may extend to imprisonment for life.
304B.source: The Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act No. 45 of 1860), Legislative Department consolidated text as republished by Goa Police: https://citizen.goapolice.gov.in/documents/10184/1794152/ipc.pdf/f7f2c816-63fe-450f-8874-0a5552959c45 (fetched 2026-09-26, sha256 576a485b22bea6127c51f8cf8e646a320ee902008b32ee0ec4dae5f28ff30511, PDF page 145). Section inserted by Act 43 of 1986, s. 10 (w.e.f. 19-11-1986).
